description: This file implements the internal logic for rendering commit graphs in a version control system, including functions for drawing lines, handling merge commits, collapsing branches, and managing graph state during traversal.

classes.name: column
classes.description: Represents a branch or parent commit column in the graph, including its associated commit and display color.

classes.name: graph_line
classes.description: Represents a line buffer used for rendering individual lines of the graph, with methods for adding characters, strings, and colors.

classes.name: git_graph
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and data structures for rendering a commit graph, including current commit, columns, mappings, and rendering state.

methods.name: graph_show_strbuf
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a strbuf line by line, optionally displaying the graph before each line.

methods.name: diff_output_prefix_callback
methods.description: Generates a prefix for diff output lines, incorporating the graph's prefix buffer.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Sets up the diff options to use the graph's prefix callback for aligned output.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Initializes a new git_graph structure, allocating necessary buffers and setting default colors.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph instance.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph state with a new commit, recalculating columns and layout.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Generates the next line of the graph output based on current state, returning whether a commit line was shown.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Displays the full commit graph lines and message for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Displays a single line summary of the current commit graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs a padding line in the graph, used for spacing or missing data.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs remaining lines of the graph until completion.
